migrate.long:
Moves accounts to another machine in an encrypted bundle.

It is a move, not a copy: a refresh token is single-use, so a login works on one machine only. With -o FILE the accounts are removed here once the bundle is written to the file. Without it the bundle goes to stdout and the accounts are removed just before it is sent: a pipe cannot tell whether the bundle arrived, so a file is safer. Until then the accounts are frozen, 5 minutes at most. The code that opens the bundle is shown once. Import the bundle once: it is the only copy of the login.

On the other machine, ccswap migrate import reads the bundle from a file, stdin or a paste and asks for the code. A bundle from stdin that cannot be imported is saved, and the command to retry is shown.
migrate.no_tty: there is no terminal to type the code in: pass it with --code
migrate.not_saved: The bundle could not be saved: %[1]s. Here it is; keep it: after %[2]s, run ccswap list, and for those of %[3]s it no longer lists, this bundle is the only copy of the login:
migrate.output_flag: write the bundle to this new file instead of stdout
migrate.paste: Paste the bundle, from its BEGIN line to its END line; text around them is ignored:
migrate.pipe_failed_saved: The bundle did not get through the pipe; the accounts are removed here already, so it is saved in %s
migrate.pipe_warning: The bundle goes to stdout: the accounts are removed here before it is written, so if it does not arrive, the login is lost. A file (-o) is safer.
migrate.read_failed: the bundle could not be read: %s
migrate.remove_failed: %s: delete this bundle yourself, its accounts stay here
migrate.replace_flag: replace the login of an account that is here already (same email)
migrate.save_failed: The bundle could not be saved: %s. Here it is; keep it, it may be the only copy of the login:
migrate.settling: The daemon has not confirmed the export yet: finding out whether it went through, up to 3 minutes. Do not interrupt ccswap: until it knows, the bundle may be the only copy of the login.
migrate.too_large: this is not a ccswap bundle: it is over 1 MiB
migrate.unknown_file: Could not learn whether the export went through; the bundle stays in %[1]s. After %[2]s, run ccswap list: if it still lists %[3]s, delete %[1]s; if not, the bundle is the only copy of the login: import it on the other machine.
migrate.unknown_saved: Could not learn whether the export went through; the bundle is saved in %[1]s. After %[2]s, run ccswap list: if it still lists %[3]s, delete %[1]s; if not, the bundle is the only copy of the login: import it on the other machine.
